notes: The monthly emission of incentives follows the formula (175,000,000 / 1.0904^n), where n is the month number starting from TGE. The split ratio of 71% for Lender & Borrower Incentives and 29% for VALAS/BNB Incentives is based on the total monthly emission.
Release schedule for treasury and airdrops is not specified, so we assume they are unlocked at TGE.
The team allocation has a 1-year cliff and then linear vesting over 4 years.
